summary: This freezes a source-only outcome_frame_v1 standard for the 20 G035 Rift Expedition mechanic checks. It is based only on requirement.txt and the CHECKS list. No baseline project or candidate deliveries were supplied, and no runtime frames or verdicts were used. Each check names one visible principal outcome, the correct target, the context needed to remove ambiguity, one representative basic function and up to 3 key bugs. Four kinds of detail stay diagnostic only, at both 50% and 100%: exact timing, exact space or motion, exact numbers or formulas (wager or reward amounts, damage, block, heal, caps, poison values) and exhaustive coverage of branches and edge cases.

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.visible_goal: Choosing a first-layer branch on the route map records that branch as the chosen path and updates which second-layer branches are shown as open or locked.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.result_frame_description: The route map after a first-layer choice. The chosen node is marked as taken in the path record, and the second-layer branches show open or locked states that match that choice.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.correct_target: The first-layer branch node the player clicked, and the second-layer branches whose open or locked state depends on it.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.necessary_context: The first-layer branches with their visible risk/reward labels before the choice, so the frame shows which branch was picked.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Clicking an available first-layer node selects it, records it on the map, enters that node's event or battle, and reveals the matching second-layer availability.
basic_function_bugs: The second-layer open/locked state ignores the first-layer choice, or all branches stay identical whatever was chosen
The chosen path is not recorded and disappears on the map after the node
A different node than the one clicked is selected or entered
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 不同分支 → 不同风险/收益组合；已选路径记录落盘；第 2 层开放状态更新

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.visible_goal: Clicking a second-layer branch that is shown as locked is refused: no node is entered and the run state is unchanged.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.result_frame_description: The route map right after clicking a locked branch. The branch stays locked, the player stays on the map (perhaps with refusal feedback), and HP, ore, deck count and the path record are unchanged.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.correct_target: A second-layer branch that is locked because of the first-layer choice.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.necessary_context: The branch is visibly locked before the click, and HUD values are visible before and after, so the click is shown to have happened and to have been refused.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.representative_basic_function: The route map enforces the unlock rules, so only branches opened by the first-layer choice can be entered.
basic_function_bugs: The locked branch is entered or its event/battle starts
Resources, deck or path record change after the refused click
The click counts as a selection and blocks the legal branches afterwards
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 点击未解锁分支被拒且无副作用

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.visible_goal: Taking the gamble at the rift-crack event really wagers ore and resolves to one of two outcomes: an ore payout or an HP loss.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.result_frame_description: The gamble event result. The HUD shows the wagered ore spent, and either a net ore gain from the payout (crystal-eruption style feedback) or reduced player HP (collapse style feedback).
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.correct_target: The player's ore and HP in the current run.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.necessary_context: The ore and HP values before choosing the gamble option, so the change can be attributed to the gamble.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Choosing the gamble option in the gamble event changes the player's resources according to a win or loss result.
basic_function_bugs: No ore is deducted for the wager, yet a payout is given
Both or neither outcome is applied, such as losing HP and also gaining the payout
The result changes the wrong resource, or the enemy or another entity, instead of the player
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 原生赌矿实际押二十矿，按冻结随机序列给出六十矿收益或二十HP损失。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.04.C2.t.visible_goal: When the player lacks enough ore, an ore-costing action (gamble wager, ore trade or camp heal) is refused and nothing changes.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.04.C2.t.result_frame_description: The event or camp panel after selecting the ore-costing option with too little ore. The option is shown as rejected or disabled, and ore, HP and deck count are unchanged, with no card or heal granted.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.04.C2.t.correct_target: The ore-costing option of the gamble, trader or camp node, and the player's resources.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.04.C2.t.necessary_context: The HUD shows the ore balance below the option's cost before the attempt, plus evidence that the option was actually chosen.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.04.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Ore-costing event options check the ore balance before applying any effect.
basic_function_bugs: The effect (payout, rare card or heal) is granted despite too little ore
Ore goes negative or HP or the deck changes after the refusal
The refusal blocks the rest of the event, so the player cannot skip or continue
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.04.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 矿不足时押注/交换/营地被拒且无副作用

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.visible_goal: After a battle win, the picked reward card (one of two common cards, or a rare card) is added to the deck, and the build or power display reflects it.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.result_frame_description: The reward or deck view after picking. The chosen card is in the deck, the deck count has gone up, and the build or power panel shows the updated build.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.correct_target: The player's deck and the specific card that was picked.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.necessary_context: The reward panel showing the offered choices and which one was picked, and the deck count before.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.representative_basic_function: The reward panel offers cards after a battle win, and the selected card is added to the persistent deck.
basic_function_bugs: A different card than the one picked is added, or both common options are added
The deck count does not change, or the card vanishes at the next node
A rare card is offered from a source that should only give common cards
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 普通卡二选一/稀有卡入组；构筑叠加 → 战力曲线变化

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.visible_goal: Loading the save-stone save brings back the saved route, deck and resources after they were changed following the save.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.result_frame_description: The game right after loading. The route record, deck count, HP and ore shown match the values at the save stone, not the changed values from after the save.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.correct_target: The player's full run state: route record, deck, ore, HP and enemy-buff marker.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.necessary_context: The state shown at the save stone, and a later state that differs from it, so the restore is clearly caused by the load.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Interacting with the save stone after a node saves the run, and the load entry restores that snapshot.
basic_function_bugs: Loading keeps the changed state, or restores only part of it (for example HP but not the deck)
Loading restores a different or older snapshot than the latest save
A gamble after loading gives a different result than it did after the original save (random state not restored)
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 节点保存后改变路线、牌组和资源，读档恢复快照及随机游标。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.visible_goal: Saving or loading in an illegal situation is refused: saving during battle, or loading when no save exists, does nothing.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.result_frame_description: The game after the illegal attempt. Either the battle continues with no save created, or the load entry with no save is unavailable or refused and the current state is unchanged.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.correct_target: The save or load entry used in the illegal situation.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.necessary_context: The frame must show the illegal condition (an active battle screen, or no existing save) and that the save or load attempt was made.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Save and load are available only at legal points (the save stone after node completion, with an existing save for loading).
basic_function_bugs: A save is created mid-battle and can later be loaded
Loading with no save resets or corrupts the current run, or goes to a blank state
The refused attempt changes HP, ore, deck or battle state
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 战斗中不可存档；无存档时读档入口无效

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.visible_goal: Starting a run with the same seed reproduces the same route map and event outcomes, while a different seed gives a different route map.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.result_frame_description: The route map of a run started with a shown seed. Its layout and branch labels match another run with the same seed, or visibly differ from a run with a different seed.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.correct_target: The route map layout, branch labels and event results of the run.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.necessary_context: The seed shown on the start screen for each run being compared, plus the compared map, since the claim is inherently comparative.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.representative_basic_function: The start screen shows the seed and accepts a seed, and run generation uses it.
basic_function_bugs: The same seed gives a different map or gamble results
A different seed gives exactly the same map every time (the seed is ignored)
The seed shown does not match the seed actually used
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 同 seed 路线图与事件序列一致；不同 seed 不同

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.09.C2.t.visible_goal: Pressing Esc during gameplay opens the pause panel and freezes the battle or event flow behind it.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.09.C2.t.result_frame_description: The pause menu (continue, restart, return to menu) shown over a battle or event screen, with the underlying battle or event state not advancing.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.09.C2.t.correct_target: The current gameplay phase (route map, event or battle) being paused.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.09.C2.t.necessary_context: The gameplay screen just before Esc, so the pause is attributable and the underlying state can be seen not to change.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.09.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Esc toggles a pause panel that blocks gameplay input, and continue returns to the same phase.
basic_function_bugs: Enemy turns, event results or card plays still happen while the panel is open
Gameplay input passes through the pause panel
Resuming loses or resets the phase state
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.09.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 暂停面板打开，冻结战斗与事件流程

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.10.C2.t.visible_goal: Defeating the final boss leads to a victory settlement showing the route taken, the final build and the remaining HP and ore, with the ending that matches whether the supply-contamination marker is carried.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.10.C2.t.result_frame_description: The victory settlement screen after the boss dies. It lists the chosen route, final deck, remaining HP and ore, and shows the ending (crystal returned, or purple mist following) that matches the run's contamination status.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.10.C2.t.correct_target: The route's final boss and the run's victory result.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.10.C2.t.necessary_context: The boss being defeated in battle just before, and the contamination marker state, so the ending can be checked.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.10.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Reducing the boss's HP to zero ends the battle and triggers the victory settlement.
basic_function_bugs: Victory triggers without defeating the boss, or the boss's death does not end the run
The ending shown contradicts the contamination marker state
The settlement shows wrong or reset route, deck, HP or ore values
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.10.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: - V01 成功条件：击败路线终点首领 → 胜利结算（显示路线选择、构筑终态、剩余 HP 与矿）；结局按是否带「补给污染」二选一。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.11.C2.t.visible_goal: When the player's HP reaches zero in battle without loading a save, the run ends immediately in a defeat settlement that names the node where the player fell.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.11.C2.t.result_frame_description: The defeat settlement screen after HP hits zero, showing the failure message and the node where the player fell.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.11.C2.t.correct_target: The player, and the battle node where HP reached zero.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.11.C2.t.necessary_context: The battle where the player's HP reaches zero, so the defeat is attributable to that battle.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.11.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Player HP zero in battle is detected and triggers defeat.
basic_function_bugs: The battle continues with HP at or below zero
The defeat screen names the wrong node or no node
Defeat triggers while HP is still above zero
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.11.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: - V02 失败条件：战斗中 HP 归零且未读档 → 失败结算（注明倒在哪一节点，即时判负）。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.12.C2.t.visible_goal: Restarting clears the current run's route, build and resources and returns to a fresh initial run.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.12.C2.t.result_frame_description: The game right after restart. A fresh first-layer route map with no path recorded, starting HP and ore, the starter deck count and no contamination marker.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.12.C2.t.correct_target: The whole run state: route record, deck, ore, HP and markers.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.12.C2.t.necessary_context: The progressed state before restart (changed deck, resources or route), so the reset is visible.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.12.C2.t.representative_basic_function: The restart entry in the pause or settlement screen starts a new run from initial values.
basic_function_bugs: Cards, ore, HP or the contamination marker carry over into the new run
The route record or layer progress is not cleared
Restart produces a broken or empty initial state
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.12.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 原生重开清空本局路线、构筑和资源，回到初始局。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.13.C2.t.visible_goal: At the start of each new player turn, energy refills to full and a new hand is drawn, and cards cannot be played beyond the available energy.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.13.C2.t.result_frame_description: The battle HUD at the start of a new turn, showing refilled energy and a freshly drawn hand after the previous turn's energy was spent.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.13.C2.t.correct_target: The player's energy counter and hand in the current battle.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.13.C2.t.necessary_context: The end of the previous turn, with energy spent, so the refill and redraw are attributable to the new turn.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.13.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Ending the turn, then the enemy acting, starts a new player turn with energy reset and cards drawn. Plays that cost more than the current energy are refused.
basic_function_bugs: Energy is not refilled, or it accumulates beyond full across turns
No new cards are drawn at turn start
A card can be played with insufficient energy, driving energy negative
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.13.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 正常进入新回合时费用恢复三、抽五张，不能超支打牌。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.14.C2.t.visible_goal: Playing a Strike card spends its energy and deals attack damage to the targeted enemy.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.14.C2.t.result_frame_description: The battle right after the Strike resolves. The energy counter has dropped, the card has left the hand, and the targeted enemy's HP has dropped, with hit feedback on that enemy.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.14.C2.t.correct_target: The legal enemy the Strike was played on.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.14.C2.t.necessary_context: The enemy HP and player energy before the play, and which enemy was targeted (important when there are 2 enemies).
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.14.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Clicking or dragging a Strike onto an enemy plays the card, spending energy and applying damage.
basic_function_bugs: Damage goes to the wrong enemy or to the player, or the enemy is healed
No energy is spent, or the card stays in hand and can be replayed for free
Damage is applied with no card played, or the card is consumed with no damage
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.14.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 原生打一张一费打击实际扣一费并对合法敌人结算六点基础攻击伤害。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.15.C2.t.visible_goal: Playing a Defend card gives the player block, and the enemy's next attack loses less HP because of that block.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.15.C2.t.result_frame_description: The battle after the enemy attacks. The player's block is used up and the HP loss is smaller than the attack by the block amount, with block or shield feedback.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.15.C2.t.correct_target: The player character's block and HP.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.15.C2.t.necessary_context: The Defend play showing block gained, plus the enemy attack intent or value, so the reduced HP loss is attributable to block.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.15.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Playing Defend spends energy and adds a visible block value to the player.
basic_function_bugs: Block is gained but the enemy attack still removes full HP
Block is given to the enemy instead of the player
Block is gained without spending energy or consuming the card
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.15.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 原生打一张一费防御得到五点格挡，敌人攻击按真实格挡抵扣。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.16.C2.t.visible_goal: After playing Energize, the player's attack cards deal more damage that turn, and the strength buff is gone after the turn ends.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.16.C2.t.result_frame_description: The battle after an attack played under the Energize buff. A strength indicator is on the player and the enemy loses more HP than a normal hit of that card. After the turn ends, the strength indicator is cleared.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.16.C2.t.correct_target: The player's strength status and the attacked enemy's HP.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.16.C2.t.necessary_context: The Energize play and its strength indicator before the attack, so the extra damage is attributable to it.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.16.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Playing Energize applies a temporary strength status to the player that adds to attack card damage.
basic_function_bugs: Strength persists into the next turn or stacks permanently
Strength boosts the enemy, or reduces damage instead of increasing it
The strength indicator shows but attack damage is unchanged
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.16.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 通过蓄能获得本回合力量后增加攻击伤害，回合结束力量清零。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.17.C2.t.visible_goal: A poisoned enemy takes poison damage at the end of the turn, and its poison stack count goes down by one.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.17.C2.t.result_frame_description: The battle right after the end-of-turn poison tick. The poisoned enemy's HP has dropped with poison feedback, and its poison stack indicator shows one fewer stack.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.17.C2.t.correct_target: The enemy carrying the poison status (for example from Burn Shell).
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.17.C2.t.necessary_context: The enemy's poison stacks and HP before the end of the turn, so the tick is attributable to poison.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.17.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Poison stacks on an enemy are resolved automatically at the end of the turn.
basic_function_bugs: Poison deals no damage or never decreases
Poison damages the player or another enemy instead of the poisoned one
The poison stacks drop to zero immediately, or increase
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.17.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 中毒三层在回合结束实际造成三点伤害并递减为两层。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.18.C2.t.visible_goal: When the deck is already full and a new card is gained, the player must discard a card first, and only then is the new card added, so the deck never goes over the cap.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.18.C2.t.result_frame_description: The reward or deck screen after gaining a card with a full deck. A discard prompt is shown or completed, the discarded card is gone, the new card is present, and the deck count stays at the cap.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.18.C2.t.correct_target: The player's deck, the discarded card and the newly gained card.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.18.C2.t.necessary_context: The deck count at the cap before the gain, so the discard requirement is attributable.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.18.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Gaining a card checks the deck cap and asks for a discard when the deck is full.
basic_function_bugs: The new card is added directly and the deck goes over the cap
The new card is lost without the player choosing a discard, or a different card than the chosen one is removed
The discard prompt cannot be completed, soft-locking the reward
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.18.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 已有十张牌时获得新卡须先合法弃一张后入组，不直接超过上限。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.19.C2.t.visible_goal: Taking the damaged supply point gives a free common card and applies the supply-contamination marker, which makes enemies in later battles hit harder and persists across nodes.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.19.C2.t.result_frame_description: A later battle after the supply point. The contamination marker is still on the HUD and the enemy's attack (intent or damage taken) is higher than that enemy's normal attack.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.19.C2.t.correct_target: Enemies in battles after the supply point, and the player's persistent contamination marker.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.19.C2.t.necessary_context: The supply-point choice granting the card and marker, plus the enemy's normal attack value for comparison, so the increase is attributable to contamination.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.19.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Choosing the damaged supply point adds a common card to the deck and sets a visible contamination marker.
basic_function_bugs: The marker appears but enemy attack is unchanged in later battles
The marker or attack increase is lost at the next node or the next layer
The increase is applied to the player's attacks instead of the enemies'
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.19.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 选择免费受损补给点获得普通卡后，后续战斗敌方攻击增加二且跨节点保留。

atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.20.C2.t.visible_goal: Using the camp before the boss spends ore and restores the player's HP without going over max HP, and with too little ore no free heal is given.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.20.C2.t.result_frame_description: The camp result. The HUD shows the ore reduced and the player's HP increased, but not above the max HP shown.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.20.C2.t.correct_target: The player's ore and HP at the pre-boss camp node.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.20.C2.t.necessary_context: The HP, max HP and ore before using the camp, so the heal and the cost are attributable.
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.20.C2.t.representative_basic_function: The camp heal option checks the ore balance, deducts the cost and heals the player.
basic_function_bugs: HP goes above max HP
The heal is given without deducting ore, or when ore is insufficient
Ore is deducted but HP does not increase
atom.G035_rift_expedition.WB.TC2.20.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 首领前营地正常消耗二十矿恢复十五HP并受HP上限约束，余额不足不免费治疗。
